scope: Reusable bottle pilot in one local market; no purchase authority.
goal: Determine whether a small physical-product pilot can be delivered within its cost and delivery limits.
current_question: Can we approve planning for a 100-unit pilot with the present supplier offer?

branch_criteria.continue: A current written quote covers 100 units within 8 euros landed cost and four weeks, with required food-contact documentation.
branch_criteria.narrow: A smaller compliant pilot fits a revised explicitly agreed budget.
branch_criteria.stop: No compliant supply route exists within the chosen constraints.
branch_criteria.unknown: Any quantity, delivery, cost or compliance condition is unverified or expired; obtain a current quote.

selection.limitation: Unlinked relevant facts may be omitted. Selection is not semantic retrieval.

records.text: Quote Q1 offered 100 units at 7 euros landed and four weeks; the quote expired on day 10.
Day 12 supplier note withdrew Q1 and offered 500 units at 6 euros, six weeks, with food-contact documents still pending.
The founder's current authorized planning ceiling is 100 units at 8 euros each; no purchase approval was issued.
A second supplier has not responded. Absence of response is not evidence that an alternative is impossible.
